'''Velusia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Velus system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Largely oceanic, it supported a wide variety of life. Rocky, volcanic islands near the equator supported a population including the [[Aquar]], a native [[Near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Description==
Velusia was located in the [[Velus system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]],<ref name="CATCW" /> at the coordinates L-9.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the second planet from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Velus]] and had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="CATCW" />

Most of Velusia's surface was covered with salty oceans. The only landmasses were scattered, rocky, and largely volcanic islands in the equatorial regions. The land was unstable, wracked by [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and volcanic activity. Numerous [[Coral/Legends|coral]] atolls were present in shallow water near the islands, and the oceans were covered in ice near the poles. Velusia's oceans were rich in suspended ores.<ref name="CATCW" />

[[File:MountHollowInVelusia.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Mount Hollow Spaceport.]]

Velusia was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[near-Human]] [[Aquar]]. The oceans supported plankton, algae, and fish, while the rocky islands supported [[Lichen/Legends|lichens]], small shrubs, and avians.<ref name="CATCW" />

Due to the land's rocky terrain, most of the planet's food was imported, although a major export was fish. Mount Hollow was the planet's largest city and the location of its only starport.<ref name="CATCW" />

==History==
Velusia was originally inhabited by a group of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who established colonies on several of the planet's islands. Over time, they formed a tribal system, eked out a subsistence living by harvesting food from the oceans and raising herd animals, and developed traits suitable for their environment, evolving into the Aquar.<ref name="CATCW" />

Thousands of years later, Velusia was discovered by scouts from the [[Nexcore Mining Corporation]] (NMC), which purchased rights from the Aquar to explore for ore deposits and established a starport and the city of [[Mount Hollow]] in the shaft of an extinct volcano. Many Aquar were hired as scouts, guides, and laborers. The NMC discovered ore and attempted to keep its knowledge of the discovery secret until the terms of the lease, which required the corporation to share its profits with the Aquar, had expired.<ref name="CATCW" />

Velusia joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to the [[Indecta Era]]. During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], it supported [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Rebellion era]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established an aggressive oceanic harvesting program on Velusia. It was rumored that a hidden [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell was located on one of the planet's islands.<ref name="CATCW" /> By [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the planet had become an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. Velusia remained under Imperial control until at least [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] and was later [[Battle of the Velus system|attacked]] and conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
The near-human Aquar were native to Velusia and originally inhabited the islands in loose tribes, but later most of them shunned the traditional lifestyle and lived in Mount Hollow. The planet had a population of 2.8 million, with a majority of 68% being Aquar.<ref name="CATCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Velusia was created by author [[Chris Doyle]] for the book ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''.
